people.name: maya
people.about: Maya, the product manager who asked for this feature. She knows what is wanted, not how the code works.

topics.topic: what should happen when staff delete a customer type that some customers still have (a type that is in use)

says.reassign: When staff delete a customer type that customers still have, move those customers to the default type and then delete it. Don't refuse the deletion.
says.refuse: When staff try to delete a customer type that customers still have, refuse it and return an error. The type and its customers stay as they are; staff have to move the customers to another type first.

topics.topic: which type a customer gets when none is chosen, and whether the default type itself can be deleted
topics.says: A customer created without a type gets the default type. The default type itself can't be deleted: someone has to make another type the default first.

topics.topic: which permission staff need to manage customer types and customer attributes
topics.says: Managing customer types and customer attributes takes the customer-type permission. The product and page permissions don't cover it.

topics.topic: whether the values of customer attributes can be translated
topics.says: No. Values of customer attributes can't be translated.
